moments.author: Markwayne Mullin
moments.quote: The United States Coast Guard pilots made the single‑engine landing feel routine. No panic, just straight professionalism. After we landed, the pilots told me that was a first for them! We could not have been in better hands.
moments.why: A dramatic mid‑air engine failure involving the DHS secretary that played out live and reassured the public, dominating conversation among men aged 25‑45.
